_meta.what: The contractualisation map: where the elected corporation NOMINALLY runs a CORE service in-house (so it scores GREEN/'corporation' in service_providers.json) but in fact OUTSOURCES the OPERATION to private contractors, concessionaires, or contract labour. Per city -> per core service -> {mode, operator(s), evidence, contract_worker_share, source, verify}. This is the third layer of the atlas: service_providers.json says WHO is nominally responsible; privatization_map.json drills the private/PPP carve-outs of whole services; THIS file exposes the hollowing of the 'in-house' cells themselves.
_meta.thesis: An 'in-house' cell on the devolution scorecard can be a shell. The statute says the corporation 'runs' sanitation, water, waste — and on the org chart it does. But the broom is held by a contract safai karmachari paid half a permanent worker's wage with no tenure; the garbage truck is a Ramky/Urbaser concession; the STP is on a private O&M contract; even property-tax discovery is outsourced to a GIS survey firm. The elected body becomes a CONTRACT-ADMINISTERING shell even where it 'runs' the service. This is Ghosh's corporate municipality plus Cooper's privatisation-as-counterrevolution, landing on Ambedkar's terrain: the contracted-out front line is overwhelmingly Dalit (Valmiki/SC safai karmacharis), so contractualisation is a CASTE-JUSTICE machine — Ambedkar's 'division of labour is also a division of labourers,' now a division between permanent (mixed-caste, benefited) and contract (Dalit, precarious) workforces doing the SAME job under the SAME municipal supervisors.

AUXILIARY_defensible_to_contract: BUILD phase of capital works (building a flyover is not the same as outsourcing road maintenance forever)
framework.normative_line: Contracting the AUXILIARY/SUPPORT functions and the one-off BUILD phase of capital works is defensible. Contracting the OPERATION of a core public service — and replacing a permanent municipal workforce with precarious contract labour doing the identical task — hollows the elected body and pushes the front line into caste-coded precarity.

mode_legend.in_house: Operated by the corporation with its own permanent staff and assets. The only truly non-contractualised mode.
mode_legend.AMC: Annual Maintenance Contract — a support/O&M contract on equipment or a facility (defensible if genuinely auxiliary; flagged where it covers core operation).
mode_legend.O&M_concession: A private firm operates and maintains a core public asset/service under a multi-year concession (e.g. SWM zone concession to Ramky/Urbaser; water O&M to OCW/Veolia). The corporation retains ownership; a private firm runs the service.
mode_legend.full_PPP: Design-Build-Finance-Operate or equivalent: private capital + private operation of the whole service for a long term.
mode_legend.contracted_labour: The corporation runs the service organisationally, but a large share of the FRONT-LINE WORKFORCE is hired through labour contractors / on outsourcing rolls / via RWAs or 'community' bodies, not as permanent municipal staff. The org chart says in-house; the payroll says outsourced.
mode_legend.mixed: A combination — typically permanent staff PLUS a large contract-labour layer PLUS some zones under O&M concession.

_meta.status: Authored 2026-06 from corporation data, NAMASTE/Socio-Economic survey data, CLRA 'Swept Aside' (2025), union/RTI-based reporting (NewsClick, Scroll, The News Minute, CenFA, Citizen Matters), Safai Karmachari Andolan. HONESTY NOTE: this is patchy RTI/budget territory. Worker-ratio figures are the most solid (well-reported, union-sourced). City-level SWM-concession facts are solid. STP O&M and property-tax outsourcing are documented in principle but per-city contract specifics are often not public — flagged verify:true. Budget proxies (contractor-payments vs establishment) are mostly NOT separable from published budgets and are flagged as such. NO fabrication.

caste_dimension_global.claim: The contracted-out front line of municipal sanitation is overwhelmingly Dalit. This is the heart of the project's Ambedkarite frame.
caste_dimension_global.evidence: NAMASTE / Socio-Economic profiling of ~38,000 sanitation workers: 68.9% SC, 14.7% OBC, 8.3% ST, ~8% general — i.e. ~77% Dalit, ~92% from SC/ST/OBC (TNM 2024). Government data on manual scavengers: ~97% SC. 2011 census: ~95% of ~1.3M scavengers were SC. The predominant caste is Valmiki/Balmiki. Safai Karmachari Andolan records 300+ sewer/septic-tank deaths a year (339 in 2022-23; 120+ alleged in 2025) — these deaths are concentrated among CONTRACT and informal de-sludging workers, not permanent staff, because contracting strips the safety, training and accountability that a permanent municipal cadre carries.
caste_dimension_global.ambedkar: Ambedkar, 'Annihilation of Caste': 'division of labour' in caste society is also a 'division of labourers' — graded, hereditary, and unequal. Contractualisation reproduces exactly this: the SAME sweeping/sewer work is split into a permanent tier (secure, mixed-caste, pensioned) and a contract tier (precarious, Dalit, denied benefits and safety) under the same municipal supervisors. The contract is the modern instrument of the old graded division.
caste_dimension_global.source: TNM '77% of manual scavengers are Dalit' (2024); NAMASTE profiling (38,000: SC 68.9% / OBC 14.7% / ST 8.3%); Safai Karmachari Andolan / Maktoob (120+ deaths 2025), IDSN; CLRA 'Swept Aside' (2025) on Ahmedabad Valmikis.

solid_waste_collection.operator: AMC door-to-door collection run through appointed private contractors ('Door/Gate to Dump', since July 2009); fleet ~1,200+ vehicles; biomedical waste to Semb Ramky Environmental Management; hotel/kitchen waste to private agencies -> Excel Industries composting.
solid_waste_collection.evidence: Collection & transport contracted to private agencies ward-wise; AMC retains ownership/oversight but the daily lift is a contractor function. ~85% of residential areas covered by contractor-run door-to-door.
solid_waste_collection.source: AMC SWM Profile (ahmedabadcity.gov.in); UNCRD 6th 3R city report Ahmedabad.

sanitation_conservancy.operator: AMC Solid Waste Mgmt dept: ~13,000-14,230 PERMANENT safai kamdar (sweepers) + ~5,000 additional workers hired via RWAs / 'Sakhi Mandali' / Valmiki Association 'as per requirement'. Total reported >18,000.
sanitation_conservancy.evidence: AMC Deputy Director (SWM) states 14,230 permanent posts (13,013 present, 1,210 vacant) and claims 'no regular contract workers — hired only as per requirement' via community bodies. That denial is itself the mechanism: a ~5,000-strong outsourced layer kept off the contract rolls via RWAs/community associations doing identical conservancy work. CLRA 'Swept Aside' (2025): Ahmedabad Valmikis funnelled into safai kamdar work after textile-mill closures; 52% in slums, 29% in AMC quarters — caste-locked into both permanent and informal sanitation rolls.
sanitation_conservancy.contract_worker_share: ~5,000 of ~18,000 (~28%) outsourced/RWA, plus an uncounted informal layer; permanent ~72%
sanitation_conservancy.source: NewKerala 'Over 18,000 sanitation workers keep Ahmedabad clean'; AMC SWM Dept figures; CLRA 'Swept Aside' (2025).

water_distribution.evidence: Production & distribution run by AMC directly; no city-wide O&M concession (unlike Nagpur).

sewerage_STP.operator: AMC sewerage; STP O&M typically on private operation-and-maintenance contracts (industry-standard 3-yr O&M), specifics not public
sewerage_STP.evidence: STP plant O&M is routinely contracted to private operators nationally; AMC-specific contract docs not surfaced.
sewerage_STP.source: general STP O&M practice; AMC-specific verify pending

property_tax_collection.operator: AMC revenue dept core; GIS/survey discovery of unassessed properties commonly outsourced (sector norm)
property_tax_collection.evidence: Collection retained in-house; property-discovery/GIS surveys are the commonly-outsourced slice. AMC-specific vendor not confirmed.
property_tax_collection.source: World Bank 'Property Taxation in India' (GIS-survey outsourcing norm)

sanitation_conservancy.operator: BMC Solid Waste Mgmt dept: ~28,000 PERMANENT + ~6,500-7,000 CONTRACT safai kamgar, PLUS ~9,000 'dattak vasti' (slum) workers via community orgs who are not even counted as contract workers.
sanitation_conservancy.evidence: Of ~35,000 sanitation workers, ~28,000 permanent and ~7,000 on contract (~20% contract on the counted rolls). Contract workers do identical duties under the same municipal officers but are paid ~Rs 14,500/mo vs ~Rs 24,000 permanent; the ~9,000 dattak-vasti workers are wholly off the books. SC 2017 ordered permanency for 2,700 contract workers after a decade-long fight; SC 2025 directed BMC to retain 580 — litigation, not policy, drives any regularisation.
sanitation_conservancy.contract_worker_share: ~20% of counted workforce on contract (~7,000/35,000); with the uncounted ~9,000 dattak-vasti layer, the genuinely-precarious share is far higher (~30-35%)
sanitation_conservancy.source: Scroll 'Jailed for keeping Mumbai clean'; IndiaSpend / Business Standard (wage gap); NewsClick (580 workers, 2025 SC order); The Week (BMC refuses permanency, 2018).

solid_waste_transport.operator: BMC SWM uses private transport/collection contractors alongside own fleet; Antony Waste Handling and others operate in the Mumbai region
solid_waste_transport.evidence: Transport/collection partly contracted; BMC retains dumping-ground and core dept. Operator mix not fully enumerated here.
solid_waste_transport.source: sector reporting; Antony Waste regional presence

water_distribution.evidence: BMC runs water directly (no O&M concession) — one of the deepest in-house municipal water operations.

public_health.evidence: Unusually deep in-house municipal health (major hospitals run by BMC) — a counter-example to contractualisation; flagged as a positive.
public_health.contract_worker_share: contract nursing/Class-IV layer exists but core is in-house

chennai._corporation: Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC); water/sewerage are CMWSSB (a state board, not GCC)

solid_waste_collection.operator: Urbaser-Sumeet (Spain's Urbaser + India's Sumeet Group) — 7 zones (9-15, ~half the city), 8-year contract signed Oct 2020, ~EUR 480M, 207 sq km, 3.7M people, 92 wards; Ramky Enviro Engineers (REEL) — 4 zones. By July 2025, 10 of 15 zones under private operators; Royapuram & Thiru Vi Ka Nagar slated for transfer.
solid_waste_collection.evidence: The clearest large-city case of conservancy privatisation: 10/15 zones handed to private SWM concessionaires. GCC remains the nominal sanitation authority (GREEN cell in service_providers.json) but the OPERATION across two-thirds of the city is private.
solid_waste_collection.contract_worker_share: majority of conservancy operation privatised (10/15 zones)
solid_waste_collection.source: Citizen Matters (Urbaser/GCC); The News Minute (worker protests); CenFA 'A Big Step Back for Chennai's Conservancy Workers'; The South First (DMK-AIADMK complicity).

sanitation_conservancy_workers.operator: Manual sweepers (predominantly women) transferred from GCC rolls to private operators; ~Rs 391/day (Rs 11,730/mo) as GCC workers became ~Rs 9,000/mo in-hand under private firms (with PF/ESI).
sanitation_conservancy_workers.evidence: Privatisation extinguished workers' long struggle for permanent GCC employment and CUT take-home pay (~Rs 11,730 -> ~Rs 9,000). A direct worsening of pay and tenure for the predominantly-Dalit, predominantly-women conservancy workforce.
sanitation_conservancy_workers.contract_worker_share: rising toward whole-city as zones transfer
sanitation_conservancy_workers.source: Citizen Matters; The News Minute; CenFA.

bengaluru._corporation: BBMP (SWM now via BSWML, a BBMP company); water/sewerage are BWSSB (state board)

sanitation_conservancy.operator: BBMP pourakarmikas: ~12,000-12,650 REGULARISED to permanent (appointment letters from 1 May, after a struggle begun 2013, via the Feb-2018 shift from contractor to Direct-Benefit/direct-payment). BUT ~10,000 remain on contract, plus ~9,000 contract garbage-truck drivers & loaders awaiting regularisation.
sanitation_conservancy.evidence: Bengaluru is the partial counter-story: sustained pourakarmika organising forced regularisation of ~12,000+ and abolition of the notorious labour-contractor (middleman) system for them — wages rose from as little as Rs 2,000-5,000/mo to ~Rs 41,000. Yet ~10,000 sweepers + ~9,000 truck crew are STILL contract. The win shows the default (contract) and the cost of reversing it.
sanitation_conservancy.contract_worker_share: ~10,000 sweepers + ~9,000 truck crew still contract vs ~12,650 regularised (~roughly half still contract)
sanitation_conservancy.source: The News Minute (victory event; 12,650 regularised); The South First (12,000+ regularised); NewsClick / The Quint (strikes); Liberation (EPFO/regularisation).

solid_waste_processing.operator: BBMP/BSWML route garbage through private processing/transport contracts; the long-running 'garbage crisis' is tied to contractor-dependent collection/transport
solid_waste_processing.evidence: Collection/transport heavily contractor-dependent; BSWML created to bring SWM into a BBMP company but operation remains contract-laden.

sanitation_conservancy.operator: GHMC: ~28,000 sanitation workers on CONTRACT and OUTSOURCING basis. Workers protest the biometric-attendance regime and demand permanency; GHMC pay-hikes explicitly EXCLUDED contract staff.
sanitation_conservancy.evidence: Roughly the ENTIRE GHMC sanitation front line (~28,000) is contract/outsourced — among the most fully-contractualised conservancy workforces of our cities. A pay revision was applied while pointedly excluding contract staff, formalising the two-tier divide.
sanitation_conservancy.contract_worker_share: ~28,000 contract/outsourced — overwhelmingly the bulk of the front line
sanitation_conservancy.source: The Hans India (GHMC sanitation workers seek pay/permanency; ~28,000 contract/outsourcing); Deccan Chronicle (pay hike not for contract staff).

property_tax_GIS.operator: GHMC deployed GIS to discover unassessed properties / allot PTINs — survey work outsourced
property_tax_GIS.evidence: Property-discovery/GIS outsourced (sector-standard auxiliary); core assessment/collection retained.
property_tax_GIS.source: World Bank 'Property Taxation in India' (GHMC GIS PTIN example)

sanitation_conservancy.operator: KMC conservancy mazdoors: ~14,000 PERMANENT posts sanctioned but only ~6,000 filled; the rest covered by casual workers drawn from the 100-days urban work programme at ~Rs 202/day.
sanitation_conservancy.evidence: KMC keeps the permanent cadre HALF-EMPTY (6,000 of 14,000 posts filled) and plugs the gap with sub-minimum-wage casual labour (~Rs 202/day) doing heavy, hazardous head-load haulage. Under-filling sanctioned permanent posts and back-filling with day-wage casuals is contractualisation by attrition.
sanitation_conservancy.contract_worker_share: ~8,000 of ~14,000 sanctioned conservancy posts run by casual/100-days-programme labour (~57% of the establishment is unfilled-and-casualised)
sanitation_conservancy.source: NewsClick 'WB: Safai Workers Under KMC Struggle With Dingy Quarters, Meagre Pay'; KMC SWM dept.

solid_waste_collection.operator: KMC door-to-door via battery/auto-tipper fleet; ~4,000 MT/day; collection crews mix permanent and casual
solid_waste_collection.evidence: Collection run by KMC with casual-heavy crews; no large single private zone-concessionaire on the Chennai model surfaced.

water_distribution.evidence: Water and sewerage run by KMC directly (no O&M concession).

water_distribution.operator: Orange City Water Pvt Ltd (OCW) — 50:50 Vishvaraj Infrastructure (Arun Lakhani) + Veolia Water (France). 25-year PPP O&M concession (~2012) for the ENTIRE urban water cycle.
water_distribution.evidence: THE sharpest municipal-core privatisation in the atlas: a 12th-Schedule function (water, not electricity) handed to a private operator running production, 5 treatment plants (~675 MLD), ~2,100 km network, billing and last-mile delivery to ~2.5M residents including slums. The elected NMC keeps formal ownership and a GREEN scorecard cell; a private firm runs the tap. Contested locally (NRW disputes, tariff/coverage). India's first big-city full water-O&M privatisation.
water_distribution.contract_worker_share: whole water-operation workforce is OCW, not NMC
water_distribution.source: privatization_map.json (nagpur.water); Veolia India concession contracts; OCW 'About Us'; SANDRP critique.

_cross_city_pattern.most_contracted_core_service: SANITATION/CONSERVANCY is the most contractualised core function across every one of our cities — either via SWM zone CONCESSIONS to private firms (Chennai: Urbaser+Ramky, 10/15 zones; Bengaluru/Mumbai transport) or, more pervasively, via CONTRACT/OUTSOURCED front-line LABOUR (Hyderabad ~28,000 contract; Mumbai ~7,000 counted + ~9,000 uncounted dattak-vasti; Bengaluru ~10,000+ still contract; Kolkata ~8,000 casual on a half-empty establishment; Ahmedabad ~5,000 RWA/community off the contract rolls). The 'in-house'/GREEN cell for sanitation is the most hollow cell on the scorecard.
_cross_city_pattern.water_exception: Water/sewerage OPERATION remains genuinely in-house in Ahmedabad, Mumbai and Kolkata (a real positive). The one full carve-out is NAGPUR (OCW/Veolia full water PPP) — the exception that proves how unusual full water privatisation still is, and how contested.
_cross_city_pattern.workforce_two_tier: Across cities the SAME conservancy work is split into a permanent tier (secure, pensioned, mixed-caste) and a contract/casual tier (precarious, sub-half wages, no tenure, denied safety). Wage gaps: Mumbai Rs 24,000 permanent vs Rs 14,500 contract; Chennai pay CUT from ~Rs 11,730 to ~Rs 9,000 on privatisation; Kolkata casuals at Rs 202/day; Bengaluru contractors once Rs 2,000-5,000/mo, regularised workers now ~Rs 41,000.
_cross_city_pattern.caste: The contract tier is overwhelmingly Dalit/Valmiki (~68.9% SC, ~77% Dalit, ~92% SC/ST/OBC in NAMASTE profiling; ~97% SC among manual scavengers). Regularisation, where it has happened (Bengaluru ~12,650; Mumbai's litigated handfuls), came only through years of organising and Supreme Court orders — never as policy. Sewer/septic deaths (SKA: 300+/yr) fall on the contract/informal layer that contracting strips of safety and accountability.
_cross_city_pattern.budget_proxy_honesty: A clean 'payments to contractors / outsourced services' vs 'establishment/salaries' split is NOT separable from most published municipal budgets at the line-item granularity needed; we flag this rather than fabricate a ratio. The workforce headcounts above are the most reliable available proxy for the scale of contractualisation.
